args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 production deployment, with an 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. In line with the runbook, we identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. Health checks now pass and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%. v2.3.1 (and its staging release candidate v2.3.1-rc) should not be redeployed until the root cause of the failure is identified and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all three production regions and was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. Verified afterwards that the service is healthy in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0002** (SEV2) against checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the recommendation that v2.3.1 not be redeployed until its failure is root-caused. The on-call engineer was paged.
